tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Return the complete public details for one Le Jurassien product using its SKU, including prices, product URL, gallery images, full description and structured attributes.

sku.description: Exact Le Jurassien product SKU returned by search_products.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the public Le Jurassien catalogue for baby and children's bedroom furniture. Returns real products, prices, URLs, images and structured attributes. Use French search terms when possible.

query.description: Product search query, preferably in French. Example: lit cabane.

bed_size.description: Optional exact bed or mattress size. Example: 80x160.

max_price.description: Optional maximum final selling price in EUR.

made_in_europe.description: When true, only return products labelled as Made in Europe.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.
